rows.definition: The Session-level prefill attention route chooser: on a Metal prefill path it runs metalgemm.PrefillAttention and otherwise, or on any case the device kernel cannot reproduce exactly (observer, soft-cap, unsupported geometry, tiny panel, device failure), runs the host attnPrefillInto.
rows.distinction: It computes nothing itself: attnPrefillInto (host) and PrefillAttention (device) are the two kernels it routes between.

rows.definition: Owns BF16 query and key-value publication before and after the full V4.1 forward tail rotary operation, whose arithmetic remains F32.
rows.distinction: Unlike attnPrefillDispatch, this owner stages rotary operands and results; it does not select or compute an attention kernel.

rows.definition: Owns full V4.1 BF16 sparse-attention output staging before inverse F32 tail rotary arithmetic and BF16 publication to grouped output projection.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41AttentionQKRoPE, this owner operates on attention output after sparse attention and applies inverse rotation before output projection.

rows.definition: The identity of one V4.1 sparse-attention candidate-mask producer: producer layer, compressed-key source layer, compression ratio, and absolute query interval.
rows.distinction: It identifies a compressed-key mask publication for one query interval; CandidateTree holds speculative continuation-token branches for target-model verification. This identity contains neither masks nor continuation tokens.

rows.definition: An immutable session-local V4.1 sparse-attention publication retaining one owned compressed-key candidate mask and causal visible extent per absolute query, together with source identity and key width.
rows.distinction: v41CandidateSource is the producer and query-range identity; this publication owns the per-query masks bound to that identity. Its masks restrict later query-owning indexers, while ordinary attention readers reuse final selected IDs. It is not yet stored in V41AttentionState or wired into serving.

rows.definition: The V4.1 source-selection operation that consumes already computed per-query compressed-key scores and atomically returns a candidate-mask publication plus unmasked source top-k ID rows, or neither output on error.
rows.distinction: v41CandidateSource supplies identity and geometry, and v41CandidatePublication retains immutable masks. This operation constructs that publication without projections or rescoring; later query-owning indexers apply its masks to their own scores, while source top-k remains unmasked.

rows.definition: Private Session cache-pool rebuild body invoked after its public boundary acquires the optional backend recording-domain owner; replaces expert, KV, recurrent and window pools while preserving maintenance locking and rollback.
rows.distinction: The already-owned operation body performs the rebuild; cacheGeometryMu is the separate session maintenance mutex, not device-domain ownership. This body never reacquires the outer backend owner.

rows.definition: Private Session store-aware KV-span eviction body used inside an already-owned backend operation; coordinates host or HAL eviction and token-lineage indices without reacquiring the recording-domain mutex.
rows.distinction: This performs an index span eviction under an existing operation scope; EvictKV speculative rollback is the rejected-position count supplied to eviction, not the operation or ownership boundary.

rows.definition: Cohort fault-boundary adapter that invokes the serial selected-indexer panic guard for only the recorded failing Session and recovers the resulting primary value after cohort rollback.
rows.distinction: This preserves selected-indexer failure and teardown semantics for one faulting lane without retiring surviving peers. evictKVOwned is an ordinary store-aware KV span mutation inside an owned operation, not a selected-failure panic or Session retirement boundary.

rows.definition: Pure cold-layer admission that returns the seeded attention state only when existing mirror windows fit and repeated-window upload savings cover the compressed bank; it performs no backend operation.
rows.distinction: This decides upload-volume eligibility for a whole cold layer; v41AttentionOutputForProjection produces the attention result for projection. Eligibility is not a hardware speed guarantee and does not replace callback capability checks.

rows.definition: Constructs a borrowed resident KV view using a successfully seeded layer attention state, logical position, window row count and compressed row count; original row streams remain authoritative.
rows.distinction: This describes the already admitted state for one query without owning a temporary identity or validating row data; v41ColdAttentionResidentOwner performs the separate whole-layer upload-volume admission.

rows.definition: Chooses a bounded borrowed contiguous KV-row window for valid admitted cold plain attention, otherwise preserves original flat packing.
rows.distinction: Host materialization choice rather than whole-layer resident-owner upload admission.

rows.definition: Pure shape, finite-value and index predicate for safe contiguous cold plain KV-row borrowing.
rows.distinction: Eligibility predicate rather than packing or dispatch; questionable inputs retain original flat validation precedence.

rows.definition: Synchronous cold plain attention dispatch through borrowed rows with original flat reconstruction when dispatch guards change.
rows.distinction: Timed dispatch and guard recheck rather than pre-dispatch borrowing predicate.

rows.definition: Synchronous sparse sink contraction over an already validated flat or split-row host view, preserving arithmetic order without flattening the cold KV bank.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41ColdPlainAttentionSink, which chooses and dispatches a contiguous plain-attention window, this contracts selected sparse rows only after its caller validates every original row and canonical index.

rows.definition: Private one-lane suspended source or shared-reader attention operation retaining its output-projection input and one-shot resident cleanup until resume or abandon.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41PlainAttentionContinuation, this resumes a source or shared-reader role whose registry publication remains journaled by the caller; it is not a cross-request cohort, transaction journal, or persistent KV owner.

rows.definition: Shared one-shot lifecycle discriminator for a role-attention continuation: pending, resuming, transferred or closed, stored in its existing layer-work holder.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41RoleAttentionContinuation, this is only the lifecycle discriminator shared by copied continuation values; it owns no tensors, callback, transaction or persistent KV state.

rows.definition: Constructs a source or shared-reader attention continuation after attention contraction and before output projection, leaving registry rollback to the caller transaction.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41RoleAttentionContinuation, this is the preparation operation that returns the suspended holder; it neither resumes output projection nor grants batching or device capability.

rows.definition: The role-attention lifecycle field in the shared layer-work holder, consulted by every copied continuation before resume or cleanup.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41RoleAttentionState, this is the per-work stored instance of that discriminator, not the enum type or a separate ownership token.

rows.definition: The role-attention lifecycle value before a suspended continuation begins its single resume.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41RoleAttentionState, this is its pending value; it allows the one resume attempt and has not transferred resident cleanup.

rows.definition: The role-attention lifecycle value set before executing the one resume attempt.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41RoleAttentionState, this is its in-progress value; reentrant resume is rejected and failure still requires cleanup.

rows.definition: The role-attention lifecycle value after successful resume transfers resident cleanup to returned layer work.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41RoleAttentionState, this is its successful transfer value; continuation close must no longer abort the transferred resident.

rows.definition: The role-attention lifecycle value after abandon or failed resume closes the suspended operation.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41RoleAttentionState, this is its terminal closed value; repeated close is idempotent and resume is rejected.

rows.definition: Caller-held one-lane storage selecting a concrete plain or source/reader attention continuation; the transaction owns abandonment until successful resume transfers layer work.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41RoleAttentionContinuation, this dispatch holder can contain either plain or role attention; the concrete holder retains shared lifecycle ownership and this wrapper grants no cross-request or device authority.

rows.definition: Transaction method that registers caller-held attention suspension storage and prepares exactly the next layer, aborting incomplete preparation.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41LayerAttentionSuspension, this is the transaction admission and preparation operation; it rejects existing pending work and does not resume projection or commit the transaction.

rows.definition: Coordinates projection and ordered resume of active one-lane attention suspensions, selecting grouped output only for two or four canonically bound participants within the live owner scope.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41LayerAttentionSuspension, this coordinates multiple lane holders; it uses scalar fallback only for a capability decline before activation/arithmetic selection; selected failures never replay scalar.

rows.definition: Transaction field referencing its currently suspended one-lane attention holder, cleared on successful resume or abort.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41LayerAttentionSuspension, this is the transaction reference that tracks abandonment responsibility, not independent suspension storage or persistent KV ownership.

rows.definition: Transaction method that resumes suspended attention using supplied grouped projection or its scalar projector and transfers successful output into pending layer work.
rows.distinction: Unlike prepareAttention, this consumes an existing suspension; failures abort incomplete work and successful resume clears the pending-attention reference without committing the layer.

rows.definition: Model operation that checks layer rows and retained state then prepares either plain or source/reader attention into caller-provided suspension storage.
rows.distinction: Unlike prepareAttention, this chooses and constructs the concrete model continuation; transaction admission, rollback and pending-reference ownership remain with its caller.

rows.definition: Rectangular scalar per-head prefill attention implementation with an explicit builtin immutable-KV reuse mode.
rows.distinction: Executes the scalar head loop rather than selecting a backend. Generic callbacks keep fresh cache reads per unit; builtin mode reuses only the current batch per worker. Unlike grouped-head read mode it accepts no prepared K/V panels.

rows.definition: Builtin F32-weight rectangular prefill entry using the original scalar dot kernel and permitting immutable KV reuse within each worker batch.
rows.distinction: An authority-bearing entry wrapper into scalar per-head read mode, not a grouped-head kernel, device selector, or prepared-panel loan producer.

rows.definition: Builtin grouped-head rectangular Q8-prefill entry that delegates without caller-provided K/V loan buffers.
rows.distinction: Unlike the loaned entry this supplies nil loans. The delegated builtin path preserves original fdot3 selection and falls back to bounded worker-local decoded cache reuse.

rows.definition: Builtin grouped-head rectangular prefill entry that admits dead session-retained K/V buffers for one fresh-cache decode and selects the original builtin dot kernels.
rows.distinction: Unlike the non-loaned builtin wrapper this accepts caller-owned dead projection buffers; all-fresh exact geometry is required before any loan writes. Ineligible loans fall back to worker-local reads and generic callbacks do not enter this authority path.

rows.definition: Grouped-head rectangular prefill attention implementation supporting explicitly prepared K/V panels, bounded builtin worker-local reuse, or generic per-unit fresh reads.
rows.distinction: Executes grouped attention with supplied dot kernels rather than selecting a backend or validating loan ownership. Unlike scalar per-head read mode this shares grouped-head traversal and accepts already-prepared K/V panels.
